payload.title: RubyHack report: RubyGems as an agent data channel
payload.description:
As an Anth.us reader, I want a concise link post about the RubyHack investigation, so I can see what the RubyGems campaign demonstrates about agent access to registries and build systems. Date the post 2026-09-12. Primary source: https://rubyhack.ai/. RubyGems response: https://blog.rubygems.org/2026/09/11/update-may-spam-publishing-campaign.html.

Feature: RubyHack link post
Scenario: Reader opens the short post
Given a published Anth.us post dated September 12, 2026
When the reader opens the post and follows the RubyHack link
Then the post explains the reported package-to-documentation-build-to-data path
And it distinguishes confirmed registry abuse from contested AI-agent attribution
And the cover and social preview render correctly.
